channel.title: Troubleshooting on HydroQC
channel.description: Recent content in Troubleshooting on HydroQC

item.title: Known Issues
item.description:
Consumption does not sync

Occasional issue

During the start or end of the billing period, consumption is not available in the portal, so HydroQC is unable to retrieve it. Wait two or three days after the start of your billing period and consumption should start syncing again on its own.

Long-term history does not sync

When the integration has been running for a while, the consumption history import can stop responding. If you plan to import your long-term historical data, restart Home Assistant before running the import.

item.title: Obtaining your account information
item.description:
The developpers of the project don’t have access to all of the account types and options available at Hydro-Quebec and rely on information provided by the users to implement them.

If your account type is not supported yet it may be helpful for us if you can provide the information available in your Hydro-Quebec customer portal.

Important

Please make sure to remove all your personal information from the outputs before sending it to us.

item.title: Diagnostic tool
item.description:
Diagnostic tool

The Hydroqc library includes a diagnostic tool to recover all the available data from your Hydro-Québec account in a format allowing us to investigate specific problems.

Important

To be used on the express request of developers only

Most problems can be resolved from available logs. Please send us diagnostic data only when asked.

Installation

At first you must install the hydroqc library in a virtual environment Python.
